title: Pars IV opens: adversaries' arguments against the Reformed position remain to be answered
source_text: I. DISPUTATIONE proxime praecedenti quaestionis hujus statum explicuimus, veramque sententiam confirmavimus iis argumentis quae nobis maxime idonea visa sunt. Restat ut excutiamus argumenta adversariorum, et eorum vanitatem, quam breviter et dilucide a nobis fieri poterit, ostendamus.
pass_a_gloss: In the disputation immediately preceding we explained the state of this question, and confirmed the true opinion with those arguments which seemed to us most suitable. It remains that we examine the arguments of the adversaries, and show their emptiness, as briefly and clearly as will be possible for us.
pass_b_english: In the immediately preceding disputation we set out the state of this question and confirmed the true view with the arguments that seemed to us most fit. What remains is to sift the adversaries' arguments and show, as briefly and clearly as we can, how empty they are.

choices.why: Period sense of shaking out arguments; examine alone loses force.
Argumentative vanity equals emptiness, not moral vanity.
